coverage_scope_note: The Odds API covers tennis odds for live and upcoming matches in a simple JSON API. Currently Grand Slams, ATP 1000 and WTA 1000 tournaments are covered, and new tournaments are periodically added.
ground_truth_date_note: matches.csv event_date is the tournament start date, so joins use tournament-window scheduled starts
reasons: Missing matched ATP/WTA evidence in at least one required year from 2022 through 2026
Stable joins are not established from the available tournament and player keys
Coverage appears limited to a narrow tournament subset
